payload.body_they: {{Name}} may spend part of their life learning the difference between working harder and having enough authority to make an impact. If they are responsible for the result but have little say over how it gets done, effort can become the only part they still control. More effort should change something: the terms, the authority, the outcome, or the next attempt. If it only changes how much of themselves they have to spend, the problem may be authority rather than effort.
